history.title: A reconstructed history
history.caveat: No source tells this life: every particular of it is ours.
paragraphs: He was born about 1812 in County Roscommon, Ireland and came to Chicago about 1858. He works as a lumber shover, and the household lives near Lake Street and the river. The family's church is Holy Family.
